svg.title: A little about me. I'm Gean, also known as Dwi, a full-stack developer in Brasília, Brazil. I build web apps, REST APIs, data pipelines and developer tools, from database modeling to the interface. Main languages: TypeScript, Python and Go. Always learning something new. I like clean APIs, fast services and good developer experience. My workflow includes AI-assisted development, MCP and coding agents. Outside the code: Linux, automation and anime.
